comparison.objective: Hold down a rail end stopper and slide a carriage off the rail; candidate adjusts a damper to stop a moving carriage safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stopper depression and linear carriage removal versus key insertion, counterholding, collar tuning, locking, control actuation, and response observation.
comparison.success_condition: Carriage passes the depressed stop and leaves the rail versus two energy-rated carriage stops within stroke and retention limits.
comparison.reason: This is the closest shared carriage/end-stop context, but it tests removal past a held stop, not dynamic energy absorption or iterative locked adjustment. No spec versions or geometric/scoring thresholds were provided.
